sources.title: Chroma clients
sources.supports: PersistentClient stores data at a selected path; client/server alternatives exist.
sources.limits: Current upstream documentation does not verify this checkout or installed dependency versions. No destructive reset example was executed.

sources.title: Chroma multi-tenancy strategies
sources.supports: Naive multi-tenancy puts enforcement responsibility on the application.
sources.limits: Not a present-version authentication implementation guide; no named auth stack selected.

sources.title: Qdrant multitenancy
sources.supports: Separate collections carry overhead; shared payload partitions are an alternative.
sources.limits: Architecture comparison only, not Chroma benchmarks or a migration recommendation. Fetch capped at 24000 characters; opening tradeoff and relevant passages inspected.

sources.title: LangGraph stores
sources.supports: Long-term namespaces can represent arbitrary groupings and are separate from threads; prefix searches can broaden scope.
sources.limits: Namespace support is not an authorization guarantee; no framework adoption selected.

sources.title: Chroma client-server mode
sources.supports: HTTP clients connect to a separate server without a whole database copy on each client.
sources.limits: No proof of current ConvMem remote service or phone app compatibility.

sources.title: PouchDB filtered replication
sources.supports: Filters do not replace authentication; changing membership and deletion fields can affect propagation.
sources.limits: Historical PouchDB 3.4.0 article; old API and purge statements are not treated as current. Corroborated for authorization distinction by S07.

sources.title: CouchDB database security
sources.supports: Database members may read all document types in the database.
sources.limits: CouchDB-specific access rules, not verified ConvMem behavior.

sources.title: Couchbase Lite replication
sources.supports: Local/remote copies, collection selection, conflict handling and checkpoints; revocation auto-purge occurs on next pull with exceptions.
sources.limits: Illustrative sync design, not adoption. Some parameter prose inconsistent; no flag advice derived. Refetched for revocation section. Modern protocol is not CouchDB-compatible.

sources.title: Couchbase database management
sources.supports: Revision pruning and tombstone purging require policies.
sources.limits: Database revision machinery does not establish permanent original-file preservation.
